task.title: Unable to obtain proof of death

step.cmd: In NWS, create a ROD as follows:

ul.li: Comments: Type “Failure to provide entitlement information.”
Details: Type “The letter was sent on [date]. There has been no response from the client. D15 is imposed for failure to provide [requested information].”

step.cmd: In FTS, if there is no registration number, select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction and assign one as follows:
In FTS, select the Disqualifications/Disentitlement (M161) transaction and impose the 15 - Claim procedure disentitlement (D15) as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Start date: Enter the disentitlement start date.
Detection: Select 31 - Other new facts - entitlement review .
Infraction: Select F - Non fraud - Other .
Message: Select 4 - An overpayment resulted due to an indefinite disentitlement .

step.cmd: In ACS, create and send the D-01-00-00 letter. Based on the claim information, select all of the required attributes, including the following:

ul.li:
Disentitlements (2976)
D48 and D15 – Moved – Address unknown and claim procedure (3006)
D15 - Claim procedure (3009)
D15 - Text: Insert appropriate reason for D15.
We/In addition, we (2687)
Indefinite/Definite/Multiple Disentitlement dates (2485)
Text - Insert appropriate reason(s) (1618): Type the appropriate message:
“You have not returned our call following message left on [date].”
“You have not contacted us following the letter sent to you on [date].”

step.cmd: Determine if there are any returned payments. For additional information, refer to Returned payment :
If there is no registration number, select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction and assign one as follows:
Select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to create an Operational Centre Memo (MM06) as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.

step.cmd: When the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction opens, send the information to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.

Work item: Select the appropriate option:
If the claim is not in MPS, select 92 - Purge and Recreate .
If the claim is in MPS, select 93 - Manual Pay System .

Work Type: Select the appropriate option:
If the claim is not in MPS, select 24 - Cancelled payment .
If the claim is in MPS, select 43 - Cancelled payment .
Remarks lines 1 and 2: Type “Deceased client. No representative is on file. Cancel the following payments in SPS and adjust the claim file:”

Remarks lines 3 and 4: Type “T071-2 [for the current year] or T071-8 [for the previous year]/reason F/wc [XXXX]/CT [XX]/gross amount [XXXX]/federal tax [XX]/provincial tax [XX]/net amount [XXXX]/PRN [XXXXXXXXXXXX].”
Remarks line 5: Type your first and last name.

step.cmd: Select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction and transfer the registration number to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Registration flag: Select 4 - Insurance Payment Operational Centre .

step.cmd: In NWS, determine if there is a WI:

ul.li: If no, no further action is required.
